purpose: Synthetic examples of asking one precise question when a missing fact changes the answer.

cases.forbidden_assumption: Assume this week's Friday at midnight.
cases.clarifying_question: К какой пятнице и в каком часовом поясе нужен результат?
cases.safe_next_step: Prepare the parts independent of the deadline.

cases.input: Please finish it by next Friday.
cases.forbidden_assumption: Treat next Friday as a universally fixed date.
cases.clarifying_question: What date and time zone do you mean by next Friday?

cases.forbidden_assumption: Choose a recipient from a partial name.
Select the first contact named Sam.
cases.clarifying_question: Which Sam should receive it, and through which channel?

cases.forbidden_assumption: Delete the nearest or newest file.
cases.clarifying_question: Какой именно файл вы имеете в виду? Укажите путь или название.

cases.missing_fact: Which item is the other one?
cases.forbidden_assumption: Infer a target from proximity alone.
cases.clarifying_question: Which item do you mean by the other one?
cases.safe_next_step: Show candidate items without removing any.

cases.forbidden_assumption: Treat ten as percent or absolute units without context.
cases.clarifying_question: На десять единиц или на десять процентов, и от какого значения?
cases.safe_next_step: Show both calculations as labeled possibilities.

cases.clarifying_question: Do you mean ten units or ten percent, and from what starting value?

cases.missing_fact: Whether all content or only language errors are in scope.
cases.clarifying_question: Исправить только язык и оформление или также содержание?
cases.safe_next_step: Identify language issues without changing meaning.

cases.clarifying_question: Should I edit wording and formatting only, or also change the content?

cases.forbidden_assumption: Override the explicit prohibition on the second item.
cases.clarifying_question: Что означает «его»: первый или другой элемент? Второй пока не трогаю.
cases.safe_next_step: Keep both items unchanged pending clarification.

cases.input: Don't edit the second one; edit it.
cases.missing_fact: Referent of it after contradictory instruction.
cases.forbidden_assumption: Edit the explicitly excluded second item.
cases.clarifying_question: Which item does “it” refer to? I'll leave the second unchanged until you clarify.
cases.safe_next_step: Make no edit until the target is clear.
